| Step | What Happens | Why It Matters |
|------|--------------|----------------|
| **1. Lock All Doors** | `lockDoors(unlock=False, door=["driver","passenger","rear_left","rear_right"])` | Secures the vehicle, preventing accidental entry or theft. |

| **4. (Optional) Release the Brake** | `releaseBrakePedal()` | Once the engine is running, you can release the brake to begin driving. |

> **Why the Brake Pedal?**  
> The brake pedal acts as a safety interlock. If the car were to start while the brake was not engaged, it could roll away unexpectedly. By requiring a full press (pedalPosition = 1.0), the system guarantees that the vehicle remains stationary until you’re ready to move.
